### Change 1: establish one role-policy authority

In [`policy.ts`](</private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-andrew-dev-crimes/ad0f3f9a-0962-407f-b4e5-9d994a4a18e5/scratchpad/wt-e6/evals/fixtures/06-stress-duplication/src/policy.ts:2>):

- Introduce one canonical `isAdmin(role)` predicate.
- Have `canEditBilling`, `canSeeAuditLog`, and `canImpersonate` delegate to it.
- Move the three sanitizer-local guards into this policy module and preserve their current truth tables:
  - [`assertAdminA`](</private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-andrew-dev-crimes/ad0f3f9a-0962-407f-b4e5-9d994a4a18e5/scratchpad/wt-e6/evals/fixtures/06-stress-duplication/src/sanitize-a.ts:6>): `isAdmin(role)`.
  - [`assertAdminB`](</private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-andrew-dev-crimes/ad0f3f9a-0962-407f-b4e5-9d994a4a18e5/scratchpad/wt-e6/evals/fixtures/06-stress-duplication/src/sanitize-b.ts:5>): `isAdmin(role) || role === "owner"`.
  - [`assertAdminC`](</private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-andrew-dev-crimes/ad0f3f9a-0962-407f-b4e5-9d994a4a18e5/scratchpad/wt-e6/evals/fixtures/06-stress-duplication/src/sanitize-c.ts:5>): `!isAdmin(role)`.

Use re-export aliases at the old module paths if those exports must remain compatible. Do not silently turn B or C into plain admin checks: B admits owners, while C currently returns true for non-admins despite its misleading name. Any correction to C should be a separately reviewed behavior change.

Add characterization tests over `admin`, `owner`, and an ordinary role. After this commit, the role-policy finding should disappear while the sanitiser duplication remains.

### Change 2: extract the canonical sanitiser

Create `src/sanitizer.ts` with one `sanitize(value: string): string` implementation containing the existing body exactly once.

Then replace the implementations in:

- [`sanitizeUserInput`](</private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-andrew-dev-crimes/ad0f3f9a-0962-407f-b4e5-9d994a4a18e5/scratchpad/wt-e6/evals/fixtures/06-stress-duplication/src/sanitize-a.ts:10>)
- [`sanitizeText`](</private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-andrew-dev-crimes/ad0f3f9a-0962-407f-b4e5-9d994a4a18e5/scratchpad/wt-e6/evals/fixtures/06-stress-duplication/src/sanitize-b.ts:9>)

with re-export aliases to the canonical function, preserving all three public names without pass-through bodies. Characterization tests should cover nullish runtime input, trimming, control characters, whitespace collapse, the 1,000-character limit, rejection conditions, and uppercase normalization.
